column1: # Canonical physical-table integer-handle range source evidence.

column5: The canonical codec now constructs the exact signed integer-handle record range for a physical table and preserves the previously translated table, record, index, and meta key authorities. Partition handles, API-V2 keyspace stripping, index ranges, and the broad row/index value, schema, checksum, collation, restored-data, and generated-column portions of the Go source remain open.
